policy_rules.rule: Pilot and fixture results may be reported only as diagnostics, not as final benchmark rankings.
Unknown-license evidence must remain pointer-only or be replaced before public redistribution.
Every public artifact must preserve upstream dataset IDs, source-row pointers, and license notes.
The benchmark is for research evaluation of grounded QA systems, not for making medical, legal, financial, climate-policy, or safety decisions.
Returned labels must satisfy calibration, double-review, citation-support, adjudication, and agreement-reporting controls before release.
